subject: reasoning
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Exactly three people are sitting between A and B when counted from the right of A. Exactly two people are sitting between D and G when counted from the left of G. B is not an immediate neighbour of G. D is sitting to the immediate left of B. Exactly three people are sitting between E and F when counted from the right of E. B and E are not immediate neighbours. How many people are sitting between E and G when counted from the right of E?
